strength.method: Person-icon HUD counts at approximately 4.167-second sampling. Two-digit OCR confidence >=0.92 with visible ticket HUD, plus reviewed low-confidence candidates. Missing readings remain null; no smoothing or interpolated flags. Observed runs end on missing or <=33 readings. Selected peaks are checked separately; entire series is not manually verified.

feed_method.grouping: Feed-row continuity and temporal name consensus; simultaneous rows preserved
feed_method.inclusion: At least 3 source observations and paired OCR score >=0.80, or 2 observations with both models agreeing and score >=0.92
feed_method.limits: One recorded POV. Hidden feed, distortion, short rows and unreadable names can still be missed. Counts are visible display episodes, not validated final kills.

feed_curation.notes: Automatic validation precedes these visual decisions; it is not replaced by the corrected result.

meta.notes: PHNT played Blue / Lonestar. The first five minutes contain a prior-round lead-in, transition and pre-scoring setup; excluded from this match's dataset. Final score checked against the result screen.
